info.title: v2.order.generate_fbs_invoices
info.description: This API creates a task to download a specific tax document (e.g., sales invoice, remessa invoice) for the seller's account, available only after the document is issued by the system as part of the Fulfilled by Shopee (FBS) process. The workflow is as follows: (1) v2.order.generate_fbs_invoices; (2) v2.order.get_fbs_invoices_result; (3) v2.order.download_fbs_invoices. Please note: The download link for the document will expire 30 minutes after being generated.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: document_status
parameters.description: 1= authorized only 2= cancelled Default: If document_status not passed or passed empty, means documents under ALL status (both authorized and cancelled) must be included

parameters.name: document_type
parameters.description: 1 = Remessa 2 = Return 3 = Symbolic Return 4 = Sale 5 = Entrada 6 = Symbolic Remessa 7 = all

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.
